digo: Kabichi; Sukumawiki (kale, Brassica oleracea var. acephala)

teaser.en: An English word that has settled into Digo: kabichi, the cabbage, and its leafy cousin that 'pushes the week'.
teaser.sw: Neno la Kiingereza lililotulia katika Kidigo: kabichi, na binamu yake wa majani 'anayesukuma wiki'.

summary.en: Kabichi is cabbage, a modern vegetable whose Digo name is borrowed from English. Pakia also lists sukumawiki, kale, the leafy non-heading form of the same species.
summary.sw: Kabichi ni mboga ya kisasa ambayo jina lake la Kidigo limeazimwa kutoka Kiingereza. Pakia pia anaorodhesha sukumawiki, aina ya spishi hiyohiyo yenye majani isiyofanya kichwa.

about.en: Cabbage is a leafy vegetable grown as an annual for its head of tightly wrapped, waxy, blue-green or pale green leaves. Sukuma wiki (kale or collards) is the same species but forms no head. Instead it grows a stem from which the large leaves are picked a few at a time over many weeks. Both belong to the mustard family and have a slightly peppery, cabbage smell when cut.
about.sw: Kabichi ni mboga ya majani inayopandwa kama mmea wa msimu mmoja kwa ajili ya kichwa chake cha majani yaliyofungamana sana, yenye nta, ya rangi ya kijani-samawati au kijani hafifu. Sukuma wiki ni spishi hiyohiyo lakini haifanyi kichwa. Badala yake hukuza shina ambalo majani yake makubwa huchumwa machache kwa wakati mmoja kwa wiki nyingi. Zote mbili ni za familia ya haradali, na hutoa harufu ya kabichi yenye ukali kidogo kama pilipili zinapokatwa.

where.en: Cabbage and kale grow best in cool weather and are major crops of the Kenyan highlands. On the hot coast they are grown in some gardens and sold in markets.
where.sw: Kabichi na sukuma wiki hustawi zaidi katika hali ya baridi na ni mazao makuu ya nyanda za juu za Kenya. Katika pwani yenye joto hupandwa katika baadhi ya bustani na huuzwa sokoni.

uses.en: The leaves are cooked as a relish (*mboga*) to eat with stiff maize porridge, or used raw in salads. *Sukuma wiki* is among the most common everyday greens in Kenya.
uses.sw: Majani hupikwa kama kitoweo (*mboga*) cha kulia na ugali, au hutumika mabichi katika saladi. *Sukuma wiki* ni mojawapo ya mboga za majani zinazoliwa zaidi kila siku nchini Kenya.

culture.en: Pakia uses *kabichi* as an example of a loanword. He lists it in his table of borrowed plant names, with English 'cabbage' as the source. He argues that names for introduced plants that are part of daily life, such as *kabichi*, *karoti* and *mtiki* (teak), are likely to stay and become settled in Digo. By contrast, scientific terms learnt at school tend to be forgotten.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia *kabichi* kama mfano wa neno la mkopo. Analiorodhesha katika jedwali lake la majina ya mimea yaliyoazimwa, chanzo chake kikiwa neno la Kiingereza 'cabbage'. Anahoji kwamba majina ya mimea iliyoletwa ambayo ni sehemu ya maisha ya kila siku, kama *kabichi*, *karoti* na *mtiki* (msaji), yana uwezekano wa kubaki na kutulia katika Kidigo. Kinyume chake, istilahi za kisayansi zinazofunzwa shuleni huelekea kusahaulika.

names.en: Digo: *kabichi*, from English 'cabbage', the same word as Swahili *kabichi*. Pakia lists *sukumawiki* separately for kale (*B. oleracea* var. *acephala*). The Swahili name *sukuma wiki* is usually explained as 'push the week', because the cheap greens stretch the household budget to the end of the week. Mgombato records *sukuma* as 'to push'.
names.sw: Kidigo: *kabichi*, kutoka Kiingereza 'cabbage', neno lilelile na *kabichi* ya Kiswahili. Pakia anaorodhesha *sukumawiki* kando kwa ajili ya *B. oleracea* var. *acephala*. Jina la Kiswahili *sukuma wiki* kwa kawaida hufafanuliwa kama 'kusukuma wiki', kwa sababu mboga hii ya bei nafuu huwezesha bajeti ya nyumbani kufika mwisho wa wiki. Mgombato inarekodi *sukuma* kama 'kusukuma'.

reason.en: Carrot, another introduced vegetable with a loan name
reason.sw: Karoti, mboga nyingine iliyoletwa yenye jina la mkopo

reason.en: Irish potato, another introduced upland crop
reason.sw: Viazi, zao jingine lililoletwa la nyanda za juu

reason.en: Amaranth, a leafy green cooked the same way
reason.sw: Mchicha, mboga ya majani inayopikwa kwa njia hiyohiyo

reason.en: African nightshade, a traditional leafy green
reason.sw: Mnavu, mboga ya majani ya jadi
